employer_match.formula_readable: The Company matches 100% of the employee's Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) contributions (excluding Catch-Up Contributions) up to a combined maximum of 4% of Eligible Earnings per payroll period. Employees of Assurance IQ receive a 50% match (effective January 1, 2024) on contributions up to 4% of Eligible Earnings, for a maximum Company match of 2% of Eligible Earnings. A true-up provision applies: in the first quarter of each Plan Year, Prudential calculates whether eligible employees received their full Company Matching Contribution for the prior year and makes an additional true-up contribution if needed.

nonelective_contribution.formula_readable: The Company may, in its sole discretion, make Qualified Non-Elective Contributions to PESP. These contributions are made other than as Matching Contributions and are allocated to participants' accounts per Treasury Regulation Section 1.401(k)-2(a)(6) or per Employee Plans Compliance Resolution System (Revenue Procedure 2021-30 or its successor). They are 100% vested and nonforfeitable when allocated, and must generally be made to the Plan by the end of the 12-month period following the applicable Plan Year. No specific percentage of pay is stated.

employee_contributions.formula_readable: Employees are always fully vested in their Before-Tax Contributions, Roth 401(k) Contributions, Catch-Up Contributions, After-Tax Contributions, Rollover Contributions, Qualified Matching Contributions, Qualified Non-Elective Contributions, and any related investment results on all those contributions.

immediate_vest_triggers: Reach age 65 while employed by the Company or any of its Affiliates
Death while employed by the Company or any of its Affiliates
Become totally disabled (eligible to receive long term disability benefits under The Prudential Welfare Benefits Plan)
Were 100% vested during a prior period of service with the Company or any of its Affiliates
Current or former employees of Assurance IQ are fully vested in Company Matching Contributions in their Assurance Match Account regardless of years of service
employer_match.formula_readable: Participants become 100% vested in Company Matching Contributions and Discretionary Company Contributions upon completing three years of Vesting Service. Vesting is also accelerated upon reaching age 65 while employed, death while employed, or becoming totally disabled. If a participant leaves before full vesting, non-vested amounts are forfeited when the Period of Separation equals five years. Current and former employees of Assurance IQ are immediately 100% vested in their Assurance Match Account contributions.

nonelective.formula_readable: Discretionary Company Contributions follow the same vesting schedule as Company Matching Contributions: participants become 100% vested upon completing three years of Vesting Service, reaching age 65 while employed, death while employed, or becoming totally disabled. Qualified Non-Elective Contributions are immediately fully vested.

eligibility.entry_dates: First day of Employment with the Company
eligibility.formula_readable: Generally, all full-time and part-time Employees are eligible to participate in PESP. Enrollment may begin on the first day of Employment. Employees who do not affirmatively elect to participate or decline within 30 days of hire (if hired on or after January 1, 2001 for Prudential, or August 1, 2023 for Assurance IQ employees) are automatically enrolled at 4% of Eligible Earnings.

employer_match.formula_readable: For Prudential employees, the Company matches 100% of Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) Contributions (excluding Catch-Up Contributions) up to a combined maximum of 4% of Eligible Earnings each payroll period. A year-end true-up contribution is provided if the full match was not received in any period but the employee contributed 4% on average for the full Plan Year. For employees of Assurance IQ, the match rate is 50% (effective January 1, 2024) of Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) Contributions up to 4% of Eligible Earnings, resulting in a maximum Company match of 2% of Eligible Earnings per year. Catch-Up Contributions are not eligible for matching.

nonelective_contribution.formula_readable: The Company may, in its sole discretion, make Qualified Non-Elective Contributions to PESP. If made on a participant's behalf, they are credited to the Qualified Non-Elective Contributions Account and are always fully vested. No fixed percentage or formula is specified.

employee_contributions.formula_readable: Employees are always fully vested in their Before-Tax Contributions, Roth 401(k) Contributions, Catch-Up Contributions, After-Tax Contributions, Rollover Contributions, and any related investment results from the date of contribution.
